title: Wagtail
blurb: Wagtails are a group of passerine birds that form the genus Motacilla in the family Motacillidae. The common name and genus name are derived from their characteristic tail pumping behaviour.
facts: Together with the pipits and longclaws they form the family Motacillidae.
